summary: Written on Dec. 1, 2023, the article lays out how Alabama (11-1, No. 8) could reach the College Football Playoff by beating No. 1 Georgia in the SEC championship. Washington's 34-31 win over Oregon already helped, and results in the Big 12, ACC and Big Ten could help further. Alabama's main obstacles are Texas, which beat it 34-24 in September, and an unbeaten Florida State.
one_line: Alabama needs to beat Georgia in the SEC title game and get help from other conference championships to reach the 2023 College Football Playoff.
key_facts: No. 8 Alabama (11-1) plays No. 1 Georgia in the SEC championship at 4 p.m. Saturday on CBS at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.
Georgia is a 5.5-point favorite over Alabama in the SEC championship game.
No. 3 Washington beat No. 5 Oregon 34-31 in the Pac-12 championship game on Friday, knocking Oregon into the two-loss pileup and out of the CFP picture.
No two-loss team has ever made the four-team College Football Playoff.
Alabama is one of eight Power 5 teams with one loss or less heading into conference championship weekend.
Texas beat Alabama 34-24 at Bryant-Denny Stadium on Sept. 9, giving the Longhorns a head-to-head edge.
No. 7 Texas plays No. 18 Oklahoma State in the Big 12 championship Saturday at 12 p.m. on ABC; a Texas loss would make life easier for Alabama.
Florida State may be without its starter and playing backup quarterback Tate Rodamaker, but it beat LSU in Week 1.
ESPN's Football Power Index ranks Alabama sixth and Texas seventh.
ESPN's strength of record ranks Alabama No. 7 and Texas No. 6.
Alabama has three wins over ranked teams this season, none over a top-10 team, so a win over Georgia would be its signature victory.
The SEC is the only conference that has put a team in the CFP every single year.
